metadata.title: Aloor Logot Gahori | Pork with Fire Grilled Tomato and Potato
metadata.description: A classic and delicious Assamese style pork dish recipe, where pork meat is cooked with fire grilled tomatoes and potatoes. This spicy and tangy pork dish is served as a side with meals in Assam.
